typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		DummyColumn as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> InputPlaceHolderScriptComponent
InputPlaceHolderScriptComponent derive(T1 = 'T,',
		T2 = right(notConvertedectfunctionstringreplicate('0', 15) + toString($RowCount), 15)) ~> TRAILERDerivedColumn
TRAILERDerivedColumn derive(TRAILER = T1 + T2) ~> TRAILER
TRAILER sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = TRAILER)) ~> FlatFileDestination
